cases.name: test Unicode survives real Workspace authors, browser attachment ack, SQLite reload and another edit
test an authored update becomes one mirror commit parented on the head it was authored against
test the author id equals the id the host computes
test the ack arrives only after the mirror log holds the commit
test a retried batch with the same op id produces no second commit and is acked
test a malformed update is refused and the mirror log is unchanged
test an oversize update is refused and the mirror log is unchanged
test an authored update reaches the other clients after the ack not before
test the attachment ignores its own commits arriving on the watch
test a head that moved underneath is retried once against the new head
test the mirror markdown after a burst of edits equals the browser text
test an epoch change refuses pending batches as blocked
test the canonical document is untouched by mirror editing
test attachment builds its doc from the library byte door and renders the mirror markdown
test the attachment status reports its text under a profile neutral key
test an append to a fixture carrying a format mark lands at the end of the rendered text
test a joining client receives the server step1 and gets step2 for its step1
test an update from one client reaches every other client and not itself
test a reconnecting client with a state vector receives only the diff
test a commit landing on the mirror from elsewhere is diffed into the attachment and fanned out
test an epoch change rebuilds the attachment and tells clients to reload
test watch loss re-attaches and resynchronises
test awareness updates fan out and a leaving client is removed
test no browser frame appends to any log in this round
test the last client leaving stops the attachment after idle
test incoming browser half-surrogate author must be refused or converge
